title: show gives contradictory guidance for a released claim: reminder demands a recovery reason while allowed_next and next offer plain claim
outcome: reminders, next, and allowed_next derive from one source; a claim released or lapsed by another session that is already accounted reads as unclaimed and plain claim is offered
acceptance: show on an item whose prior claim was released by another session prints no recovery-reason reminder and offers plain claim; the recovery reminder appears only when claim(recovery_reason_required) is the allowed operation

completion.summary: Unified agent-facing claim guidance around exact allowed_next and safe show routing; added deterministic regressions, updated dogfood fixtures and docs, passed every required gate, and completed clean Codex/Claude frozen review.
